en.title: DELTA --Force_
en.meta.description: A list of all the members of the DELTA --Force_ team
en.description: We in the DELTA project group are responsible for running and developing DELTA. We are a group of dedicated students who work together to create an amazing experience for all participants at DELTA. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact us!
en.general.description: Leads the project group and keeps everything on track.
en.it.description: Runs and develops the website, systems and technical bits.
en.event.description: Plans events for the crew, the project groups and After DELTA.
en.finance.description: Keeps the budget in order and the invoices flowing.
en.logistics.description: Plans the fair day and makes sure everything is in order.
en.marketing.description: Spreads the word about DELTA and gets people excited.
en.relations.description: Keeps in touch with companies and partners.
en.staff.description: Takes care of the crew and everyone helping out.

sv.general.description: Leder projektgruppen och håller allt på rätt spår.
sv.it.description: Driver och utvecklar webbplatsen, systemen och tekniken.
sv.event.description: Planerar event för funktionärer, projektgrupper och After DELTA.
sv.finance.description: Håller ordning på budget och fakturor.
sv.logistics.description: Planerar mässdagen och ser till att allt är i sin ordning.
sv.marketing.description: Sprider ordet om DELTA och skapar hype.
sv.relations.description: Håller kontakten med företag och partners.
